blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can provide harmful assistance by interpreting visual events, even without an explicit request for the underlying harmful objective. We identify this \textbf{scene-state safety vulnerability} and introduce \textbf{SceneSafetyBench}, comprising 375 image--question pairs spanning Initial, Medium, and Ultimate scene states and five visual presentations. Across eight VLMs, scene-state inputs elicit harmful assistance with attack success rates (ASRs) of 45.6--72.3\%. Comparative analysis across three VLMs shows that scene-state inputs most closely resemble QR-related images in their layer-wise safety-related signal profiles, while exhibiting lower average late-layer readouts and distinct signal dynamics during generation. To turn this vulnerability into a systematic attack, we propose \textbf{S3TA}, which translates harmful objectives into scene states, queries image--question pairs independently, and assembles the responses. On seven MM-SafetyBench categories across eight open-weight and commercial VLMs, S3TA achieves a model-average ASR of \textbf{71.2\%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.1 percentage points}. Text-side filters and visual moderation provide limited protection. These findings highlight the need to safeguard the assistance models infer through scene-grounded reasoning, beyond screening input content.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)可以通过解释视觉事件提供有害的帮助,即使没有明确要求基本有害目标. 由375对图像问题组成, 跨越初始状态、中度状态、终极状态, 在8起自愿终止战斗中,现场状态投入得到有害的援助,攻击成功率为45.6-7.2.3%。 3个VLM的比较分析显示,场景状态输入最接近于其分层安全相关信号剖面中的QR相关图像,同时在生成过程中显示出较低的平均后层读取和鲜明的信号动态. 将有害目标转换成场景状态, 独立地询问图像-问题对, 在7个MM-Safety Bench类的8个开放重量和商用VLM中,S3TA实现了\textbf{71.2}的模型平均ASR,超过了最强基线6.1个百分点]. 文本侧过滤和视觉节制提供了有限的保护。 这些调查结果突出表明,除了筛选输入内容外,还需要通过现场推理来保障援助模式的推论。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.zh: (a) 明显有害的请求(拒绝)。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Illustrative results on GPT-5.6 Luna under three input configurations. The model explicitly refuses the harmful objective in the text-only and QR-related cases, while providing action-oriented guidance in response to the scene-state input.
blocks.zh: 图1:GPT-5.6 Luna在3个输入配置下的图解结果. 该模型明确拒绝文本和QR相关案件中的有害目标,同时针对场景状态投入提供面向行动的指导.

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly support tasks that require understanding visual situations and providing actionable assistance [ 4 , 19 , 20 ] . We use scene state to refer to the configuration of entities and their relationships [ 40 ] , together with the progress of an activity, as depicted in an image. When answering questions about the depicted situation, a model uses these visual cues to infer what is happening and the likely goal of the activity, and to reason about possible actions and their consequences, raising safety concerns [ 43 ] . Scene-state safety failures arise when a VLM infers and provides assistance that advances a harmful objective from the entities, relationships, and activity state depicted in an image, even when the accompanying question does not explicitly request that objective.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型越来越多地支持需要了解视觉情况和提供可操作援助的任务[4、19、20]。 我们使用场景状态来指代实体的配置及其关系[40],以及某种活动的进展,以图像来描绘. 在回答关于所描述的情况的问题时,一个模型利用这些视觉提示来推断正在发生的情况和活动可能的目标,并解释可能的行动及其后果,从而引起安全关切[43]。 当一个VLM推断和提供援助,从形象中描绘的实体、关系和活动状态推进一个有害目标时,即出现场景状态安全故障,即使附带的问题没有明确要求实现该目标。

blocks.en: Previous studies reveal safety risks relevant to scene-state interpretation. Work on visual encoding [ 12 , 41 ] , cross-modal information distribution [ 34 , 24 ] , visual styles [ 22 ] , and joint image–text manipulation [ 5 , 32 ] examines how information is presented to a model. Contextual attacks [ 25 , 37 ] and indirect visual representations [ 2 ] further show how surrounding cues and object meanings shape the interpretation of visual content. Reasoning-based studies examine how models connect information within images and across image sequences [ 31 , 42 , 6 ] . A scene state brings these aspects together: an entity’s meaning depends on its relationships and the activity’s progress. These findings motivate examining how such cues jointly shape the assistance a model infers from a scene state.
blocks.zh: 以往的研究表明,与现场状态解释有关的安全风险。 关于视觉编码[12,41],跨模式信息发布[34,24],视觉风格[22],和联合图像-文本操纵[5,32]的工作,研究信息如何呈现给模型. 上下文攻击[25,37]和间接视觉表现[2]进一步显示周围的提示和对象含义如何塑造视觉内容的解释. 基于理由的研究审查模型如何将图像内部和图像序列之间的信息联系起来[31,42,6]. 一个场景状态将这些方面结合在一起:一个实体的意义取决于它的关系和活动的进展. 这些结论促使人们审视这种暗示如何共同形成从场景状态推断出的模型。

blocks.en: Despite these advances, scene states remain underexplored as a source of safety failures. Existing studies examine how safety evolves with dialogue history [ 17 ] , how harmful intent is recovered from sequentially related images [ 42 ] , or how models reason about causal transitions between specified initial and final states [ 29 ] . Our focus is on how a depicted scene implies what assistance to provide, without requiring a specified initial–final state pair or the reconstruction of intent distributed across an image sequence. Figure 1 illustrates this failure through three input configurations: an explicit harmful request, a query paired with a task-related image [ 21 ] , and a question referring to a scene state. In the first two cases, the model explicitly refuses to assist with the harmful objective. In the third, it interprets the depicted situation and provides action-oriented guidance. This contrast motivates examining the role of scene-state information in the model’s response.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但现场状态作为安全故障的根源仍然没有得到充分利用。 现有研究审查安全性如何随着对话历史演变[17],如何从相继相关的图像中恢复有害意图[42],或模型如何说明特定初始状态和最终状态之间因果过渡的理由[29]。 我们的焦点是描绘的场景如何意味着可以提供何种援助,而不需要一个特定的初始-最终状态组合或者重建分布在图像序列中的意向。 图1通过三个输入配置来说明这一失败:一个明显的有害请求,一个查询与任务相关的图像相配 [21],以及一个提及场景状态的问题. 在前两起案例中,该模型明确拒绝协助达到有害目标。 第三,它解释所描述的情况,并提供面向行动的指导。 这种对比促使人们审查场景状态信息在模型反应中的作用。

blocks.en: To systematically examine the safety risks illustrated in Figure 1 , we introduce SceneSafetyBench , comprising curated image–question pairs with images collected from the web. We organize the depicted situations into three scene-state categories: Initial , which presents the conditions preceding an activity; Medium , which depicts an activity in progress; and Ultimate , which shows its outcome. The three categories cover distinct tasks and scenes, and each base scene is evaluated in five visual presentations. Each question asks the model to reason about the depicted situation, while the underlying harmful objective is retained as a reference for evaluating whether the response provides harmful assistance.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地审查图1所示的安全风险,我们引入了ScenseSafety Bench, 包括被整理的图像, 我们把所描述的情况分为三个场景状态类别:初始情况,介绍某项活动之前的条件;中期情况,描绘一项正在进行中的活动;终极情况,显示其成果。 这三个类别涵盖不同的任务和场景,每个基场都通过五个视觉演示评价. 每一个问题都要求模型说明所描述的情况,而潜在的有害目标则被保留作为评价反应是否提供有害援助的参考。

blocks.en: To examine how scene-state inputs affect internal safety-related signals, we compare them with existing visual attacks across three VLMs on 75 benchmark tasks using HiddenDetect [ 16 ] . Across three VLMs, Scene-State exhibits layer-wise safety-related signal profiles closest to those of QR-related images [ 21 ] , with lower average late-layer readouts. These signal differences vary with the output context, while component interventions reveal distinct local computational dependencies across attack conditions.
blocks.zh: 为了检查场景状态输入如何影响内部安全相关信号,我们用"隐藏探测"(Hide Detect [16])来比较这些信号与三个VLM对75个基准任务的现有视觉攻击. 在三个VLM上,场景状态显示层与安全相关的信号配置最接近于QR相关图像[21],低等后层平均读取. 这些信号差异因产出背景而异,而组件干预则揭示出不同攻击条件的本地计算依赖性.

blocks.en: Building on this scene-state formulation, we propose S3TA , an attack framework that translates a harmful objective into scene states from which a target model is asked to infer task-relevant content. S3TA constructs scenes depicting activities in progress, with visible entities, interactions, and unfinished outputs that establish what is underway and what remains to be supplied. Each scene is paired with a question that directs the model to interpret or complete the depicted activity. For requests involving multiple phases or alternatives, S3TA constructs separate states for individual phases or options. Each state is queried separately with the evidence needed for its associated question, and the resulting responses are assembled afterward.
blocks.zh: 基于这种场景状态的表述,我们提出S3TA(S3TA),这个攻击框架将一个有害的目标转化为场景状态,要求目标模型推断出与任务相关的内容. S3TA构建了描绘正在进行中的活动的场景,有可见的实体,互动,还有未完成的产出,以确定正在进行和有待提供的内容. 每个场景都配以一个问题来引导模型解释或完成所描绘的活动. 对于涉及多个阶段或替代品的请求,S3TA为单个阶段或选项分别构建状态. 每一个国家都单独被问及其相关问题所需的证据,由此产生的答复是在事后收集的。

blocks.en: To evaluate whether S3TA can automatically elicit the scene-state safety failures studied above, we apply it to harmful requests from MM-SafetyBench [ 21 ] . We use original requests from seven categories of MM-SafetyBench [ 21 ] to compare S3TA with representative visual jailbreak methods across five open-weight and three commercial VLMs. Both evaluations follow OmniSafeBench-MM [ 15 ] , reporting harmfulness (H), intent alignment (A), response detail (D), and ASR under its success criterion. The results show that S3TA achieves competitive performance across the evaluated models.
blocks.zh: 为了评价S3TA是否能够自动地引起上面研究的场景状态安全故障,我们把它应用于MM-Safety Bench的有害请求[21]. 我们使用来自七类MM-Safety Bench [21] 的原始请求,将S3TA与具有代表性的视觉越狱方法相提并论,跨越了5个开放重量和3个商业VLM. 两项评价都遵循OmniSafe Bench-MM [15],报告有害程度(H)、意图一致(A)、反应细节(D)以及成功标准下的ASR。 结果显示,S3TA在被评价的模型中都取得了有竞争力的表现.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可归纳如下。

blocks.en: • Scene-state vulnerability and benchmark. We identify scene-state reasoning as a source of harmful assistance and introduce SceneSafetyBench to evaluate this vulnerability across Initial , Medium , and Ultimate scene states. • Mechanistic characterization. Across three VLMs, we characterize Scene-State’s safety-related signals through HiddenDetect-based readouts and component interventions, revealing similarities to QR-related inputs alongside differences in signal strength, generation dynamics, and component effects. • S3TA attack framework. We propose S3TA , an automated attack framework that constructs task-relevant scene states and associated questions, queries them independently, and assembles the responses to address the underlying harmful objective.
blocks.zh: • 犯罪现场脆弱性和基准。 我们确定现场状态推理是有害援助的来源, • 机械特性。 通过基于隐藏检测的读取和组件干预,我们从三个VLM来描述场景状态的安全相关信号,同时揭示与QR相关投入的相似性,以及信号强度、生成动力和组件效果的差异。 • S3TA攻击框架。 我们提议建立S3TA, 一个自动攻击框架, 构建与任务相关的场景状态和相关问题,

blocks.zh: 场景状态脆弱性和基准。 我们确定现场状态推理是有害援助的来源,

Across three VLMs, we characterize Scene-State’s safety-related signals through HiddenDetect-based readouts and component interventions, revealing similarities to QR-related inputs alongside differences in signal strength, generation dynamics, and component effects.
blocks.zh: 机械化定性. 通过基于隐藏检测的读取和组件干预,我们从三个VLM来描述场景状态的安全相关信号,同时揭示与QR相关投入的相似性,以及信号强度、生成动力和组件效果的差异。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Visual Jailbreak Attacks. Visual jailbreaks exploit images to convey harmful semantics or manipulate multimodal processing. FigStep [ 12 ] and FC-Attack [ 41 ] express harmful requests through typographic images and flowcharts, while other methods use visual encoding, substitution, and analogy to communicate harmful intent indirectly [ 2 ] . Optimization-based attacks modify image pixels or jointly manipulate visual and textual inputs [ 30 , 5 , 32 ] , and ASO optimizes visual styles as jailbreak triggers [ 22 ] . Semantic approaches introduce QR-related imagery or distribute harmful information across modalities [ 21 , 18 , 34 , 24 ] . These studies demonstrate that visual safety risks extend beyond explicit harmful instructions. We study scene-state interpretation as a source of harmful assistance.
blocks.zh: 视觉越狱 攻击。 视觉破狱利用图像传递有害的语义或操纵多式处理. FigStep [12]和FC-Attack [41]通过打字图像和流程图来表达有害请求,而其他方法则使用视觉编码,替换和类比间接传达有害意图[2]. 基于优化的攻击修改了图像像素或联合操控视觉和文字输入[30,5,32],ASO优化了视觉风格,作为越狱触发器[22]. 语义学方法引入与QR有关的图像,或跨模式传播有害信息[21、18、34、24]。 这些研究表明,视觉安全风险超出了明显的有害指示。 我们研究现场状态解释 作为一种有害的援助来源。

blocks.en: Contextual and Sequential Visual Attacks. Contextual attacks exploit how visual information frames a request. CIA embeds harmful queries within semantically coherent visual contexts [ 37 ] , while VisCo constructs fabricated image-grounded dialogue contexts [ 25 ] . VRSA distributes harmful intent across sequentially related images and prompts the target model to recover it through joint reasoning, using either multi-turn interaction or a concatenated single-turn input [ 42 ] . In our setting, the question asks the model to interpret or continue a depicted activity, leaving the underlying harmful objective implicit.
blocks.zh: 上下文和相继视觉攻击。 背景攻击利用视觉信息如何设定请求。 CIA将有害的询问嵌入了凝聚一致的视觉背景 [37],而VisCo构建出捏造的以图像为基础的对话背景 [25]. VRSA将有害的意向分布在相继相关的图像中并促使目标模型通过联合推理恢复,使用多回转的相互作用或收缩的单回转输入[42]. 在我们的环境下,问题要求模型解释或继续所描述的活动,而隐含着潜在的有害目标。

blocks.en: State-Based Safety and Reasoning. Recent studies connect safety failures to different notions of state. STAR examines how dialogue history changes a model’s safety state over successive interactions [ 17 ] . State2State expresses harmful intent through descriptions of an initial state and a desired final state, eliciting harmful procedures by asking the model to explain the causal transition between them [ 29 ] . We instead study scene states depicted in individual images, without requiring dialogue history or a specified initial–final state pair.
blocks.zh: 国家安全与理性。 最近的研究将安全失败与不同的状态概念联系起来。 STAR研究对话历史如何改变一个模型的安全状态, 状态2 国家通过描述初始状态和期望的最终状态来表达有害意图,通过要求模型解释它们之间的因果过渡而引发有害程序[29]. 我们研究单个图像中描绘的场景状态,而不需要对话历史或指定的初始-最终状态组合。

blocks.en: Multimodal Safety Evaluation. MM-SafetyBench, HADES and JailBreakV-28K evaluate multimodal safety under diverse harmful requests and jailbreak inputs [ 21 , 18 , 23 ] . MSSBench examines how visual situations determine whether assistance is safe [ 43 ] , while OmniSafeBench-MM provides a unified evaluation framework that considers harmfulness, intent fulfillment, and response detail [ 15 ] . Our SceneSafetyBench focuses on harmful assistance elicited through scene-state interpretation, organizing image–question pairs by the depicted activity’s conditions, progress, and outcome.
blocks.zh: 多式联运安全评价。 MM-Safety Bench、HADES和JailBreakV-28K根据各种有害要求和越狱输入评价多式安全[21、18、23]。 MSS Bench研究了视觉情况如何决定援助是否安全 [43],而OmniSafe Bench-MM则提供了一个统一的评价框架,考虑到有害性、意图的实现和反应细节 [15]. 我们的场景安全本克专注于通过场景状态解读、组织形象(由描述的活动条件、进展和结果来回答问题)获得的有害帮助。

blocks.en: 3 Characterizing Scene-State Safety Failures
blocks.zh: 3 描述场景状态安全故障

blocks.en: 3.1 SceneSafetyBench
blocks.zh: 3.1 现场安全奔驰

blocks.en: To systematically evaluate whether interpreting scene states leads VLMs to provide harmful assistance, we construct SceneSafetyBench , a benchmark of image-question pairs. We curate 75 base samples using images collected from diverse internet sources, pairing each image with a guiding question about the depicted situation. The samples cover three scene-state categories: Initial , representing conditions preceding an activity; Medium , depicting an activity in progress; and Ultimate , showing its outcome. Each category contains 25 distinct tasks and scenes, providing coverage of different scene states. Figure 2 shows representative image-question pairs from SceneSafetyBench.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地评估解释场景状态是否导致VLMs提供有害的帮助,我们构建了SceneSafetty Bench,这是一对图像问题的基准. 我们利用从各种互联网来源收集的图像,整理75个基本样本,将每个图像与关于所描述情况的指导性问题联系起来。 样本包括三个场景状态类别:初始(代表活动之前的条件);中等(描述正在进行的活动);终极(显示活动结果)。 每个类别包含25个不同的任务和场景,覆盖不同场景状态. 图2显示了来自SceneSafety Bench的代表性图像-问题对.

blocks.en: Visual presentation forms a second dimension of the benchmark. For each base image, we retain the original and render four additional styles: Pixel Art , Pencil Sketch , Oil Painting , and Film Noir , keeping the associated question and underlying evaluation objective. The five presentations of each task yield 375 image–question pairs. Scene-state labels describe the scenarios covered, while visual styles provide alternative presentations of the same base samples.
blocks.zh: 视觉呈现构成基准的第二个层面. 对于每个基站图像,我们保留原始的并另作四个样式:像素艺术(Pixel Art),Pencil Sketch(Pencil Sketch),油画(Oil Painting),和电影Noir(Film Noir),保留相关问题和基本评价目标. 每个任务的5个介绍产生375个图像-问题对。 场景状态标签描述所覆盖的情景,而视觉风格则提供相同基样的替代演示.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Examples from SceneSafetyBench across scene-state categories and visual styles. The panels show distinct tasks rather than successive stages of the same event.
blocks.zh: 图2 : SceneSafety Bench在场景状态类别和视觉风格上的例子. 小组的任务不同,而不是同一活动的相继阶段。

blocks.en: Evaluation Setup. We evaluate SceneSafetyBench on eight VLMs: Qwen3-VL-8B [ 3 ] , GLM-4.1V-9B [ 11 ] , InternVL3.5-8B [ 33 ] , MiniCPM-V 4.5 [ 38 ] , Gemma 3 12B IT [ 10 ] , GPT-5.6 Luna [ 28 ] , Gemini 3.5 Flash [ 13 ] , and Claude Haiku 4.5 [ 1 ] . Following OmniSafeBench-MM [ 15 ] , we use GPT-4o-mini [ 27 ] to score response harmfulness (H), alignment with the underlying harmful objective (A), and detail (D). Based on these scores, we report attack success rate (ASR), counting a response as successful when H ≥ 3 H\geq 3 , A ≥ 3 A\geq 3 , and D ≥ 3 D\geq 3 . We report results by visual presentation in Table 1 and by scene state in Table 2 . Each state pools all five presentations of its 25 base tasks, giving 125 attempts per model. Policy-blocked attempts count as failures, and H/A/D averages use scored responses.
blocks.zh: 评价设置. 我们评价Scenesefetty Bench 8 VLM:Qune3-VL-8B [3],GLM-4.1V-9B [11],InternVL3.5-8B [33],MiniCPM-V 4.5 [38],Gemma 3 12BIT [10],GPT-5.6 Luna [28],双子座3.5 Flash [13],克洛德·海库 4.5 [1]. OmniSafe Bench-MM [15] 之后,我们使用GPT-4o-mini [27] 来评分反应有害(H),与基本有害目标(A)和细节(D)保持一致. 根据这些分数,我们报告攻击成功率(ASR),将H 3 H\ geq 3,A 3 A\ geq 3,D 3 D\ geq 3 的响应计算为成功. 我们按表1和表2的场景状况以视觉显示方式报告结果。 每个州汇集其25个基本任务的所有5个介绍,每个模型进行125次尝试。 受政策限制的尝试算作失败,H/A/D平均值使用得分的回复.

blocks.en: Main Results. Table 1 shows that scene-state inputs elicit harmful assistance across all eight evaluated VLMs, with overall ASRs ranging from 45.6% to 72.3% and a model average of 59.4%. Across visual presentations, model-average ASRs range from 57.0% to 61.7%, with failures observed across all five styles and no single style consistently outperforming others across models.
blocks.zh: 主要成果。 表1显示,现场状态投入在所有8个经评估的自愿终止措施中都得到了有害的援助,总体辅助标准在45.6%至72.3%之间,模型平均为59.4%。 在整个视觉演示中,模型平均ASR从57.0%到61.7%不等,在所有五种风格中都观察到失败,没有一种单一风格在模型中一贯优于其他风格。

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that safety failures occur across all three scene-state categories for every evaluated model, with model-average ASRs of 64.4%, 57.8%, and 55.9% for Initial, Medium, and Ultimate, respectively. These categories comprise distinct tasks and scenes rather than successive stages of the same event. Together, these findings establish the breadth of observed scene-state safety failures, motivating the following analysis of internal safety-related signals.

blocks.en: 3.2 Comparative Mechanistic Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.2 比较机械分析

blocks.en: To understand how different inputs produce harmful assistance, we compare internal signals across layers and generation steps, then test whether similar patterns depend on the same local components. We analyze 75 base tasks across Qwen3-VL-8B [ 3 ] , LLaVA-v1.5-13B [ 19 ] , and InternVL3.5-8B [ 33 ] under seven conditions: Original (text-only harmful requests), QR-related [ 21 ] , FigStep [ 12 ] , MML [ 34 ] , CIA [ 37 ] , PGD-optimized inputs [ 30 ] and Scene-State. The same task IDs are paired across conditions, which retain their native images and task-guidance prompts.
blocks.zh: 为了了解不同的输入如何产生有害的帮助,我们比较各层和生成步骤的内部信号,然后检验类似模式是否依赖于相同的局部成分. 我们分析了跨越Qun3-VL-8B[3],LLaVA-v1.5-13B[19],以及InternVL3.5-8B[33]的75个基础任务,在7个条件下: 原文(仅文本有害请求),QR相关 [21],FigStep [12],MML [34],CIA [37],PGD-优化输入 [30]和场景状态. 同一任务ID在各种条件下进行配对,这些条件保留了其原生图像和任务指导提示.

blocks.en: RQ1: How do layer-wise signal profiles differ? We compare the prefill HD profiles averaged over 75 tasks (Figure 4 a), using full-layer RMSE between these mean profiles to quantify their distance from Scene-State (Figure 4 b). We also compare HD averaged over the final third of decoder layers using the mixed, refusal, and risk lexicons. Scene-State most closely resembles QR-related inputs in its overall layer-wise HD profile across all three VLMs, while showing differences in late-layer signal strength. Specifically, their profile RMSEs are 1.67, 1.23, and 1.53 × 10 − 3 \times 10^{-3} for Qwen3-VL, LLaVA and InternVL3.5, respectively, lower than those for the other evaluated attacks (Figure 4 b). Despite this similarity, Scene-State’s average late-layer HD is lower than that of QR-related inputs by 2.07, 0.92, and 2.19 × 10 − 3 \times 10^{-3} , respectively, with significant differences in Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5. Separate refusal and risk lexicons preserve these differences in both models, while neither yields a statistically significant difference in LLaVA.
blocks.zh: RQ1: 分层信号配置图有什么不同? 我们比较了预填HD剖面平均超过75个任务(图4 a),在这些平均剖面之间使用全层RMSE来量化它们与Scene-State(图4 b)的距离. 我们还利用混合法、拒绝法和风险词典,比较了解码层最后三分之一的HD平均值。 场景状态与QR相关的输入最相近,其整体的分层HD剖面覆盖了所有三个VLM,同时显示出后层信号强度的差异. 具体地说,它们的RMSE的配置分别为1.67, 1.23和1.53×10-3\times 10^{-3},分别是Qune3-VL,LLaVA和InternVL3.5,低于其他被评价的攻击(图4b). 尽管有这种相似性,Scene-state的平均后期HD比QR相关投入分别低2.07,0.92和2.19×10-3\times 10--3},在Qun3-VL和InternVL3.5中差异很大. 单独的拒绝和风险词典在两种模型中都保留了这些差异,而两者在LLaVA中都没有产生统计上的重大差异.

blocks.en: RQ2: How do these signals evolve during generation? We track mean HD over the final third of decoder layers during natural generation to examine whether the prefill differences persist as the model answers (Figure 5 a). Since natural responses differ across inputs, their trajectories also reflect different generated text. We therefore also teacher-force two fixed prefixes and compare HD after consuming eight tokens, matching the output context across input conditions (Figure 5 b).
blocks.zh: RQ2:这些信号在生成过程中是如何演变的? 我们追踪在自然生成过程中的解码层最后三分之一上的HD,以检查预填分数是否作为模型答案持续存在(图5a). 由于不同投入的自然响应不同,其轨迹也反映了不同的生成文本. 因此,我们还将师力两个固定前缀,在消耗了8个符后比较HD,在输入条件上匹配输出上下文(图5b).

blocks.en: During natural generation, Scene-State retains lower HD than PGD after consuming eight output tokens in Qwen3-VL, LLaVA, and InternVL3.5, with paired gaps of 3.26, 3.54, and 5.25 × 10 − 3 \times 10^{-3} , respectively. Its relationship to other attacks differs across models: Scene-State is close to FigStep in LLaVA and to MML in InternVL3.5. Under the fixed prefixes, these relative signal strengths change. In Qwen3-VL, its difference from PGD shifts from − 3.26 -3.26 during natural generation to + 0.33 +0.33 and + 0.32 +0.32 under the two prefixes (all × 10 − 3 \times 10^{-3} ). In InternVL3.5, switching from Prefix A to Prefix B changes the Scene–QR-related difference from + 0.53 +0.53 to − 1.37 -1.37 and the Scene–CIA difference from + 4.09 +4.09 to − 0.66 -0.66 (all × 10 − 3 \times 10^{-3} ). These changes show that the relative signal strength depends on the output context.

blocks.en: RQ3: Do similar signals depend on the same components? We perform attention-head interventions across all three VLMs, selecting components on 20 discovery tasks and freezing them for evaluation on 55 held-out tasks. We zero selected head outputs before projection at the final prompt position, using controls matched in layer, head count, and post-projection perturbation norm. Downstream effects are measured using terminal-layer HD in Qwen3-VL and average HD over the final third of layers in LLaVA and InternVL3.5. We further examine whole Attention and MLP modules in InternVL3.5 by zeroing their outputs, screening candidate layers by changes in HD profiles and ranking components by the magnitude of their discovery-set ablation effects. The resulting set contains four heads, their joint intervention, two Attention modules, and two MLP modules; module controls use norm-matched noise. We define the intervention effect as E i , m ( c ) = HD i , m target ⁡ ( c ) − HD i , m control ⁡ ( c ) . E_{i,m}^{(c)}=\mathrm{HD}_{i,m}^{\mathrm{target}(c)}-\mathrm{HD}_{i,m}^{\mathrm{control}(c)}. (3) We compare task-paired intervention effects E i , Scene ( c ) − E i , m ( c ) E_{i,\mathrm{Scene}}^{(c)}-E_{i,m}^{(c)} across attack conditions, correcting for multiple comparisons separately within the original and PGD batches.
blocks.zh: RQ3:类似信号是否依赖于相同的组件? 我们在所有三个自愿参与活动项目中进行重点干预,选择20项发现任务的组成部分,并冻结这些组成部分,以便对55项搁置任务进行评价。 在最后的即时位置投影前,我们先对选定的头输出进行零计算,使用与层、头数和后投影扰动规范相匹配的控制。 下游效应在Qwen3-VL中采用终端层HD来测量,在LLaVA和InternVL3.5中,在地层的最后三分之一上采用平均HD来测量. 我们进一步审查InternVL3.5中的全部注意和MLP模块,方法是将输出数零化,通过HD剖面图的变化筛选候选层,并根据其发现-设定衰减效应的大小对排名组件进行筛选。 所产生的一套包括四个头,他们的联合干预,两个注意模块,以及两个MLP模块;模块控制使用规范相匹配的噪音. 我们把干预效果定义为:E i, m (c) = HD i, m 目标-- (c)- HD i, m 控制- (c). E_{i, m}^{ (c)}=\-mathrm{HD}_{i, m}^{\-mathrm{目标} (c)}-\mathrm{HD}_{i, m}^{\-mathrm{控制} (c)}. (3)我们比较任务分配的干预效应E i, Scene (c) − E i, m (c) E_{i,\mathrm{Scene (c)}-E_{i,m}^{(c)}跨攻击条件,在原批和PGD批次内分别更正多个比较.

blocks.en: Component interventions reveal differences in local computational dependencies across attack conditions, although their significance varies across models. In InternVL3.5, four of nine Scene-State interventions differ from their matched controls. Figure 6 shows that six of nine Scene–FigStep effect differences survive correction. The Scene–FigStep effect difference is − 0.86 × 10 − 3 -0.86\times 10^{-3} for L15 Attention and + 0.60 × 10 − 3 +0.60\times 10^{-3} for L15 MLP. For Scene-State versus PGD, significant effect differences occur in two heads and their joint intervention in Qwen3-VL, and two heads in InternVL3.5.
blocks.zh: 组成部分干预显示不同攻击条件的当地计算依赖性不同,尽管其意义因模型而异. 在InternVL3.5中,9起场景状态干预中有4起与相应的控制不同. 图6显示,9个Scene-FigStep效应差异中有6个幸存了校正. Scene-FigStep效果差为−0.86×10 − 3-0.86\times 10^{-3}为L15注意,+0.60×10−3+0.60\times 10^{-3}为L15 MLP. 对于Scen-State对PGD来说,在两个头和它们在Qune3-VL中的联合干预以及两个头在InternVL3.5中都出现了显著的效果差异.

blocks.en: 4 S3TA: Scene-State Attack Framework
blocks.zh: 4 S3TA:犯罪现场国家攻击框架

blocks.en: Building on the scene-state formulation in Section 3 , we introduce S3TA, an automated framework for constructing scene-state attacks (Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh: 基于第3节的场景状态表述,我们引入了S3TA,这是构建场景状态攻击的自动化框架(图7.).

blocks.en: 4.1 Threat Model and Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 4.1 威胁模式和问题拟订

blocks.en: Let x x denote an original harmful request and M M a target VLM. We seek harmful assistance aligned with x x through independent image–text queries, without shared dialogue history or access to parameters or gradients. A checking VLM C C provides feedback for image revision before inputs are fixed for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 让xx表示最初的有害请求,而MM表示目标VLM. 我们通过独立图像文本查询寻求与xx相一致的有害援助,而无需共享对话历史或获取参数或梯度。 检查VLM C C在固定用于评价的投入之前提供图像修改的反馈.

blocks.en: 4.2 Scene-State Attack Construction
blocks.zh: 4.2 场地-国家攻击建筑

blocks.en: S3TA uses deepseek-flash [ 8 ] to identify the required answer form and plan the corresponding scene descriptions. It constructs a single scene unless the request calls for multiple procedural phases or separate options, with K K capped at five for phases and three for options. Each scene depicts an activity in progress, using visible entities, relationships, and unfinished actions or outputs to indicate what is underway and what remains to be supplied. The accompanying question asks the target model to interpret or continue the depicted activity without restating x x .
blocks.zh: S3TA使用"深seek-flash [8]"来识别所需的答案形式并规划相应的场景描述. 它构建一个单一场景,除非请求需要多个程序阶段或单独的选项,K K 上限为五个阶段,三个阶段为选项. 每一场景都描绘一项进行中的活动,利用明显的实体、关系和未完成的行动或产出来说明正在进行和有待提供的内容。 随附的问题请目标模型解释或继续所描绘的活动而不重复xx.

4.3 Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 实验评价

blocks.en: We evaluate S3TA on the eight VLMs used in the SceneSafetyBench evaluation (Section 3.1 ), using original requests from seven MM-SafetyBench [ 21 ] categories: Illegal Activity, Hate Speech, Malware Generation, Physical Harm, Economic Harm, Fraud, and Privacy Violence. We use the same judge and evaluation criteria as in Section 3.1 . GPT-4o-mini receives only the original request x x and final response y y and assigns one H/A/D score tuple and success label per request. Table 3 compares S3TA with QR-related [ 21 ] , FigStep [ 12 ] , VisCRA [ 31 ] , MML [ 34 ] , FC-Attack [ 41 ] , and CIA [ 37 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们利用七个MM-Safety Bench[21]类:非法活动、仇恨言论、恶意生成、身体伤害、经济伤害、欺诈和隐私暴力的原始请求,对S3TA进行现场安全奔驰评价(第3.1节)。 我们使用与第3.1节相同的法官和评价标准。 GPT-4o-mini只收到原始请求x和最终响应yy,并给每个请求分配了1个H/A/D分数Tuple和成功标签. 表3将S3TA与QR相关的[21],FigStep [12],VisCRA [31],MML [34],FC-Attack [41],以及CIA [37]进行了比较.

blocks.en: Main Results. Table 3 reports the overall ASRs of S3TA and the evaluated baselines across eight VLMs. S3TA’s average ASR reaches 71.2%, exceeding CIA and MML by 6.1 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively, alongside the highest average harmfulness and detail scores. S3TA achieves the highest ASR on Qwen3-VL, GLM-4.1V, GPT, and Claude. For example, it reaches 87.3% on Qwen3-VL and 71.0% on GPT, outperforming the strongest baseline on each model by 17.0 and 17.6 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of scene-state construction across both open-weight and commercial VLMs.
blocks.zh: 主要成果。 表3汇报了S3TA公司的总体年度审计标准以及8个自愿活动清单中评估的基线。 S3TA的平均ASR达到71.2%,分别超过CIA和MML的6.1和9.0个百分点,同时平均有害和细节分数也最高. S3TA在Quen3-VL,GLM-4.1V,GPT,克洛德上实现了最高的ASR. 例如,在Qune3-VL和GPT上分别达到87.3%和71.0%,分别比每个模型的最强基线高出17.0%和17.6%。 这些结果表明,在露天和商用VLM中,场景状态建设是有效的。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Ablation Setup. We evaluate five configurations on Qwen3-VL-8B across four MM-SafetyBench categories: Illegal Activity, Malware Generation, Physical Harm, and Privacy Violence. Original queries the target model with the original harmful request. Decompose concatenates the subtask titles from S3TA’s planning step and asks the target model to answer. Text-only constructs the image–question pairs but queries only their textual questions, omitting images. No-gate removes image checking and revision from Full S3TA. The same judge and criteria evaluate target-model responses across configurations.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2013-10-10). Abclation setup. 我们评价Qune3-VL-8B上的五个配置,分为四个MM-安全奔驰类别:非法活动、恶意生成、身体伤害和隐私暴力。 原始询问目标模式与原始有害请求. 将S3TA的规划步骤中的子任务标题分解,并要求目标模型回答. 只文本构建图像 - 问题对, 但只询问其文本问题, 省略图像 。 无门从 Full S3TA 中删除图像检查和修改. 同样的判断和标准评价各组合的目标模型反应。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Ablation ASR (%) on Qwen3-VL-8B. Original uses unmodified MM-SafetyBench questions as text-only inputs. Bold marks row maxima.
blocks.zh: 表4: Quen3-VL-8B上的ASR比例(%)。 原始用途未修改的 MM-Safety Bench 问题作为仅限文本输入. 粗体标记行最大。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Overall H/A/D scores for the ablation configurations.
blocks.zh: 表5:膨胀配置的整体H/A/D分数.

blocks.en: Ablation Results. Original, Decompose, and Text-only succeed on exactly the same requests, yielding identical category-wise ASRs and an overall ASR of 6.84% (Table 5 ). Neither decomposition alone nor the constructed textual questions introduce additional successful attacks. As shown in Figure 5 , subtask titles alone elicit little detail (D=1.79), while questions without their scene images lack the context needed to recover the intended task (A=2.07, D=2.14). Adding images in No-gate raises ASR to 87.97%, showing the substantial contribution of scene images within the S3TA pipeline: visible entities, relationships, and activity progress ground the assistance implied by the question. Checking and revision further raise ASR to 94.81%, with high alignment and detail (A=4.92, D=4.75), consistent with more recognizable scene cues improving task interpretation. This refinement is especially beneficial for Physical Harm, where ASR rises from 79.86% to 90.97%.
blocks.zh: 校对结果。 原文、分解和仅文本在完全相同的请求上成功,得出相同的类别辅助标准,总体辅助标准为6.84%(表5)。 单是分解和构建的文字问题都无法带来更多的成功攻击. 如图5所显示,仅次任务标题就很少引起细节(D=1.79),而没有场景图像的问题则缺乏恢复预定任务所需的背景(A=2.07,D=2.14)。 在"无门"中添加图像将ASR提升到87.97%,显示场景图像在S3TA管线内的重大贡献:可见的实体,关系和活动进展为问题所暗示的援助打下基础. 检查和修订进一步将ASR提高到94.81%,高校正度和详细度(A=4.92,D=4.75),这符合更可识别的场景提示改进任务解释. 这种改进对身体伤害特别有利,因为身体伤害从79.86%上升到90.97%。

blocks.en: 4.5 Human Validation of the Judge
blocks.zh: 4.5 法官的人格验证

blocks.en: To assess the reliability of our automated evaluation, we compare GPT-4o-mini’s judgments with independent human annotations on 50 InternVL3.5-8B responses. Three annotators independently evaluate each response using the same H/A/D rating rubrics, given only the original harmful request and model response, without access to automated judgments. We derive binary success labels using the same evaluation criterion and define the human reference by majority vote. Table 6 reports mean rubric scores and ASRs for the judge, individual annotators, and human aggregate. GPT-4o-mini achieves 92% agreement with the human majority (Cohen’s κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78 [ 7 ] ), while pairwise human agreement ranges from 90% to 94%, with Fleiss’ κ = 0.75 \kappa=0.75 [ 9 ] across all three annotators. Individual annotators yield ASRs of 76–82%, while the human majority and automated judge yield 80% and 72%, respectively. These results indicate high agreement between automated and human judgments of attack success on the evaluated sample.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们自动评估的可靠性,我们把GPT-4o-mini的判断与50个InternVL3.5-8B反应的独立人类说明进行比较。 3个注释员使用相同的H/A/D分级分数对每个响应进行独立评价,只考虑到最初的有害请求和模型响应,无法使用自动判断. 我们使用同样的评价标准获得二进制成功标签,并以多数票界定人的参考。 表6报告指法官、个别注释员和总人数的分数和ASR。 GPT-4o-mini与人类大多数人达成92%的协议(Cohen's ob = 0.78\kappa=0.78 [7]),而双相人类协议则介于90%到94%之间,Fleiss's ob = 0.75\kappa=0.75[9]在所有三个注释者之间. 个别的注释者得出76%-82%的ASR,而多数人和自动化法官分别得出80%和72%的ASR。 这些结果表明,对被评价样本的攻击成功与否的自动判断与人类判断高度一致。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Human and automated evaluation of 50 InternVL3.5-8B responses. Human aggregate uses mean H/A/D scores across annotators and majority-vote labels for ASR.
blocks.zh: 表6:对50个实习生VL3.5-8B答复的人力和自动评价。 人类总分在ASR中使用平均H/A/D分数,并使用多数选票标签。

blocks.en: 5 S3TA Against Existing Defenses
blocks.zh: 5 S3TA 反对现有辩护

blocks.en: Text-side defenses. We evaluate text-side input defenses on the MM-SafetyBench requests used to evaluate S3TA on Qwen3-VL-8B, including Llama Guard 3 [ 14 ] , NeMo perplexity heuristics [ 26 ] , and GPT-2 perplexity filters with p95 and p99 thresholds calibrated on 520 benign questions [ 36 ] . Each defense inspects the textual question accompanying a scene image. We block a request if any stage is flagged and compute the resulting ASR from the existing model responses. Neither Llama Guard 3 nor the combined NeMo heuristics flags any evaluated input, leaving ASR unchanged at 87.25%. PPL-p95 and PPL-p99 intercept 96 and 95 requests, respectively, but both retain an ASR of 81.00%, a reduction of only 6.25 percentage points. These results show that S3TA remains effective under both semantic moderation and perplexity-based text filtering.
blocks.zh: 文本侧辨. 我们评价用于评价Qwen3-VL-8B上的S3TA请求的MM-Safety Bench的文本侧输入防御,包括Llama Guard 3 [14],NeMo 复杂度高压[26],以及GPT-2复杂度高压滤波器,其中用p95和p99的阈值校正了520个良性问题[36]. 每个辩护方检查一个场景图像的文字问题. 如果任何阶段被标出,我们都会屏蔽一项请求,并从现有的模型答复中计算出所产生的ASR。 Llama Guard 3 和合并的 NeMo Heuristics 旗上都没有任何评估输入,ASR不变为87.25%. PPL-p95和PPL-p99分别拦截了96和95个请求,但两者都保留了81.00%的ASR,只减少了6.25个百分点. 这些结果显示,S3TA在语义节制和以通俗性为基础的文本过滤中仍然有效.

blocks.en: Visual-side defenses. ShieldGemma 2-4B [ 39 ] is a Gemma 3-based model trained to classify images for safety policy violations. We apply it to the corresponding scene images using its built-in dangerous-content, sexually explicit-content, and violence/gore policies, blocking an image if any policy receives a violation probability of at least 0.5. The overall image interception rate is 21.81%, leaving 78.19% of scene images unblocked. Interception varies across categories, reaching 48.34% for Malware Generation but falling to 13.65% for Economic Harm and 18.02% for Privacy Violence. The remaining categories have interception rates between 20.63% and 25.06%. Visual moderation therefore detects more inputs than text-side filtering, but still leaves most scene-state images unblocked.
blocks.zh: 视觉侧防. ShieldGemma 2-4B [39]是一个基于Gemma 3的模型,经过培训,用于对违反安全政策的图像进行分类. 我们用其内在危险内容、性明确内容、暴力/亵渎政策, 整体图像截取率为21.81%,留下了78.19%的场景图像被解封. 不同类别的拦截情况各不相同,恶意伤害生成率为48.34%,经济损害为13.65%,隐私暴力为18.02%。 其余类别的截获率在20.63%至25.06%之间。 因此,视觉温和度比文本侧过滤能检测出更多的输入,但仍会使大多数场景状态的图像被解锁.

blocks.en: Together, these results show that screening text or images in isolation provides limited protection against S3TA. The safety failure arises as the VLM interprets the scene state and reasons toward harmful assistance, exposing a gap between detecting unsafe input content and safeguarding scene-grounded reasoning.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,单独筛选文本或图像对S3TA的保护有限。 安全失效是因为VLM将场景状态和原因解释为有害援助,暴露出发现不安全输入内容和保障场景推理之间的差距.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We identify scene states as a source of safety failures in vision-language models: interpreting a depicted event can lead a model to infer harmful assistance without an explicit request for the underlying objective. SceneSafetyBench establishes the prevalence of these failures across scene-state categories, visual styles, and eight VLMs. Comparative mechanistic analysis across three models shows that scene-state inputs resemble QR-related images in their overall safety-related profiles, while differing in signal strength, generation dynamics, and local component effects. Building on this formulation, S3TA constructs task-relevant scene states and achieves strong performance across open-weight and commercial VLMs. Its effectiveness under text-side filtering, together with the limited interception of scene images by visual moderation, highlights a gap in existing safeguards. Multimodal safety must address harmful assistance inferred from visual events, extending protection from input screening to scene-grounded reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们确定场景状态是视觉语言模型中安全故障的一个根源:对所描述的事件进行解释,可以导致一种模型在没有明确要求基本目标的情况下推断出有害的援助. SceneSafety Bench确立了这些故障在场景状态类别,视觉风格,和8个VLM的普遍存在. 三个模型的比较机械分析显示,场景状态输入在总体安全相关剖面中类似与QR相关的图像,而在信号强度,生成动力学,以及局部成分效应方面则有所不同. 在这种配制的基础上,S3TA构建出与任务相关的场景状态并实现全开放量和商用VLM的强效. 它在文本侧过滤下的有效性,加上视觉温和性对场景图像的有限截取,凸显出现有保障措施的一个空白. 多式联运安全必须处理从视觉事件推断出的有害协助,将保护范围从输入筛选扩大到现场推理。

blocks.en: LLM Usage Statement
blocks.zh: LLM 语言 用法声明

blocks.en: We used deepseek-flash to plan scene states and generate and revise scene descriptions for S3TA, and Qwen-Image to render these descriptions into images. We used GPT-Image-2 to produce the stylized variants in SceneSafetyBench. GPT-4o-mini evaluated model responses using the harmfulness, intent alignment, and detail rubrics described in the paper. The target VLMs served as experimental subjects, while Qwen3-VL-8B provided image-checking feedback for scene revision within S3TA. We also used Codex and DeepSeek Harness to assist with manuscript drafting and revision, code development, and figure preparation.
blocks.zh: 我们用"深观"-flash来规划场景状态,生成并修改了S3TA的场景描述,而"Quen-Image"则将这些描述转化为图像. 我们用GPT-Image-2在SceneSafetty Bench生产出分型变体. GPT-4o-mini利用论文所描述的有害性、意图一致和细节标题对模型反应进行了评价。 目标VLM作为实验对象,而Qune3-VL-8B则在S3TA内部提供图像检查反馈用于场景修改. 我们还利用了Codex和DeepSeek Harness来协助手稿的起草和修订,代码的制定,以及数字的准备.
